title: Account Late-Fee Record and Age: Courtesy Share Table for the Crestline Credit Card
content:
On a Crestline Credit Card account, the share of a late fee that a Northgate courtesy credit applies to its credit basis has a starting point that depends on the account's late-fee record and age, with months counted as whole calendar months up to today: when at least one late fee besides the one being credited was posted fewer than 12 months before today (two or more late fees in that time, the credited one included) and the account was opened fewer than 24 months before today, the share starts from 0.5 in place of 1.0; when such another late fee exists and the account was opened 24 months or more before today, it starts from 0.75 in place of 1.0; otherwise it starts from 1.0.

## Starting-point table

| Late fees posted fewer than 12 months before today (credited one included) | Account opened before today | Share starts from |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | fewer than 24 whole months | 0.5 (50 percent) |
| two or more | 24 whole months or more | 0.75 (75 percent) |
| fewer than two | any | 1.0 (100 percent) |

## Where the figures come from

- **Late fees in the last 12 months:** the late fee entries on the card ledger posted fewer than 12 months before today.
- **Account age:** the account's open date, counted in whole calendar months to today.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

- Opened 23 whole months ago, with a second late fee posted 5 months ago: 0.5. The same record on an account opened 24 whole months ago: 0.75.
- A second late fee posted 12 months or more before today is outside the count; with only the credited fee in the 12 months the share starts from 1.0.
